_comment: Advisories accepted under docs/dependency-policy.md 'Required verification' item 6:
every entry carries reachability, owner, expiry and a compensating control, and an
EXPIRED entry fails the audit rather than silently continuing to suppress. Accept an
advisory ONLY when there is no fixed upstream release; if a fix exists, take the fix.
Enforced by scripts/python_audit.py, invoked from `make python-audit`.

accepted.reachability: Transitive, via cognee only (diskcache is not a direct dependency). The advisory is arbitrary code execution through DiskCache's default pickle serialization, and it requires WRITE access to the cache directory. Boltrig gives cognee a dedicated named volume at BOLTRIG_COGNEE_ROOT (/var/lib/boltrig/cognee) inside a container whose root filesystem is read_only, and nothing but the kernel process writes there. The cache directory is never shared between tenants and is never attacker-writable over any request path, so an actor able to exploit this already holds code execution inside the container.
accepted.compensating_control: Dedicated per-stack named volume (not a shared or world-writable path); read_only root filesystem with only /tmp writable (x-app-hardening); the knowledge subsystem is default-OFF and only reaches cognee when a manifest explicitly enables it.
accepted.reason: No fixed release exists upstream: pip-audit reports the advisory with an empty fix-versions list. Re-check at expiry and take the fix the moment python-diskcache publishes one.
